claim: Patchline carries a soundness theorem proving that every 'safe' verdict implies the absence of the modeled hazard class, so a green light is a logical guarantee over the model rather than a heuristic. The worker checks every modeled hazard class has a soundness lemma with a checked proof. The gate proves every hazard class is covered by a sound, proof-backed lemma and that a class asserted safe without a proof is rejected.
